description: This file declares the SimpleBufferPool class, which manages memory buffers with allocation and deallocation functionalities, including shared pointer support. It appears to be part of a buffer management system within a larger project.

classes.name: SimpleBufferPool
classes.description: A class that manages a pool of buffers, providing methods for allocation, deallocation, and shared buffer management.

methods.name: allocate
methods.description: Template method to allocate a buffer of a specified type and count.

methods.name: allocateShared
methods.description: Template method to allocate a shared pointer to a buffer of a specified type and count.

methods.name: deallocate
methods.description: Method to deallocate a buffer pointed to by a void pointer.
